jobs.occupation: Head of Digital – E-com to Lindex, Gothenburg
jobs.description:
The opportunity
This is an opportunity to shape digital e-commerce within a company that operates its infrastructure in-house and retains responsibility for the stability and development of its platforms. Lindex has established digital channels and a customer base of approximately six million members.
You lead a team of managers, leaders, UX designers and software developers. The role combines long-term direction with practical responsibility for platform performance, personalisation and customer journey development, giving you the opportunity to influence how technology supports business results.
About the role
You are a senior digital leader with a strong commercial mindset and a proven ability to connect digital strategy with business performance. You understand how e-commerce, data, AI and technology drive growth, profitability and customer experience, and know how to translate business ambitions into clear digital priorities, roadmaps and measurable results.
You bring extensive experience leading complex digital ecosystems, including websites, apps and commerce platforms, and understand how these contribute to the broader retail business and customer journey. With a strong focus on commercial performance, you drive the development of digital capabilities that strengthen customer engagement, personalisation and conversion while ensuring scalable, efficient and high-performing platforms.
As an influential and collaborative leader, you align business and technology stakeholders around shared priorities, balance operational excellence with innovation and drive continuous digital development. You also drive digital maturity, AI adoption and competence development, strengthening the organisation’s ability to capture new opportunities and maintain a competitive position in a rapidly evolving market.
The Head of Digital – E-com holds full accountability for the business team's digital direction, capabilities and contribution to commercial, financial, operational, sustainability and people performance. The role reports to the Chief Digital Officer (CDO).
Key responsibilities
Define the strategic digital direction and roadmap e-commerce.
Lead the development and operation of Lindex app, website, commerce backend and continuous improvements.
Ensure stable, secure and reliable platforms with minimal disruption.
Deliver word-class customer journeys, platform performance and conversion.
Elevate personalisation across Lindex digital customer experience.
Translate commercial objectives into technology priorities, digital capabilities and delivery plans.
Lead the work and strengthen the use of data, artificial intelligence, automation and modern digital ways of working.
Lead a team of digital professionals, including software developers, UX designers and digital managers.
Contribute to the overall digital transformation as part of the Digital & Tech Management Team, driving digital competence development, AI adoption and new ways of working across the organisation.
Establish strategic leadership and clear ownership of digital partners and suppliers, ensuring strong performance and alignment with business objectives.

About you
You combine strategic digital leadership with the ability to turn customer and business needs into clear technology priorities. You consider the trade-offs between operational stability, continuous improvement and new capabilities. As a leader, you create clarity across teams and reporting lines, develop people and communicate complex decisions in a direct and accessible way.
To succeed in the role, you need:
A relevant university degree or equivalent professional experience.
Extensive experience in digital development and technology within a business context.
Leadership experience from digital products, platforms or customer-facing technology.
Documented experience of translating business strategy into digital capabilities and execution.
Experience developing robust digital customer journeys, e-commerce solutions or comparable high-volume services.
Experience leading agile delivery, roadmaps and backlog prioritisation across multiple disciplines.
Strong communication skills and fluency in English.

It is an advantage if you have:
Experience with personalisation, data, analytics, automation and AI
Experience improving digital conversion and customer experience.
Experience leading across reporting lines and shared areas of responsibility.
Experience from retail, e-commerce or another industry with complex, customer-facing digital platforms.
Experience from fashion, apparel, retail or another design-led product environment.

Location and Application
The position is based at the company’s head office in Gothenburg and requires regular on-site presence. International travel may be required.
We warmly welcome your application by 22 November via maquire.se (https://maquire.se/lediga-jobb/). If you have any questions, please contact Igor Glavan, 0701-765828, igor.glavan@jerrie.se or Jonna Berglöv, 0763-034100, jonna.berglov@jerrie.se
Maquire applies a fair selection process based on a clearly defined role profile. We do not use AI for screening or selection. Every application is reviewed by a human.

jobs.occupation: Head of Digital – Sales & Marketing / B2B to Lindex, Gothenburg
jobs.description:
The opportunity
This is an opportunity to shape a new world-class digital area that supports one of Lindex prioritised growth engines. You hold a broad mandate across B2B, Sales & Marketing, combining strategic influence with direct involvement in delivery. The role offers close collaboration with commercial and technology stakeholders, as well as the opportunity to build practical structures, methods and capabilities that support scalable growth, stronger customer relationships and more effective marketing.
About the role
As Head of Digital – Sales & Marketing / B2B, you hold strategic responsibility for the digital direction, capabilities and contribution to business performance across Lindex B2B and the Sales & Marketing functions at Lindex. You translate Lindex overall strategy into a clear digital direction, setting priorities and driving the development of digital solutions, data, AI and technology to enable sustainable growth, profitability and long-term business success.
Working in close partnership with business and functional leaders, you ensure that digital priorities are aligned with commercial objectives and translated into tangible results. With an initial focus on enabling B2B growth and scalable partner integrations, you lead digital development across the area, combining strategic direction with hands-on execution. This includes developing digital roadmaps, integration capabilities and shared solutions that strengthen commercial performance and support an expanding B2B ecosystem.
You lead a small team and drive competence development in new digital capabilities and ways of working, strengthening the organisation’s digital maturity and ability to embrace future opportunities. Through close collaboration across business, technology and operations, you ensure that digital development supports both current business needs and long-term strategic ambitions.
The Head of Digital – Sales & Marketing/B2B holds full accountability for the business team's digital direction, capabilities and contribution to commercial, financial, operational, sustainability and people performance. The role reports to the Chief Digital Officer (CDO).
Key responsibilities
Define the digital direction, priorities and roadmap for digital B2B and Sales & Marketing.
Enable scalable B2B expansion by assessing technical feasibility in early commercial discussions.
Initiate partner integrations and define requirements for APIs, system architecture and data flows.
Translate commercial needs into digital capabilities, delivery priorities and actionable plans.
Develop methods and operating models for marketing, including effective briefing processes and distribution of marketing materials from a digital perspective.
Balance priorities across digital B2B and Sales & Marketing based on business value and available capacity.
Lead and develop a small team of digital professionals across digital B2B and Sales & Marketing.
Collaborate with technology vendors, partners, suppliers and internal operations teams to deliver sustainable solutions.
Contribute to the overall digital transformation as part of the Digital & Tech Management Team, driving digital competence development, AI adoption and new ways of working across the organisation.
Establish strategic leadership and clear ownership of digital partners and suppliers, ensuring strong performance and alignment with business objectives.

About you
You combine commercial understanding with strong digital and technical judgement. You can move comfortably between early business discussions, integration requirements and practical delivery. With a small team, you remain close to the work, create clarity across shared responsibilities and focus on solutions that can be implemented and scaled rather than building unnecessary structures.
To succeed in the role, you need:
A relevant university degree or equivalent professional experience.
Extensive experience in digital and technology within a business context.
Leadership experience and the ability to lead people and priorities across reporting lines.
Experience translating business strategy into digital capabilities and execution.
Experience working with B2B integrations, APIs, system architecture or data flows.
The ability to assess technical opportunities and constraints in commercial discussions.
Strong communication skills and fluency in English

It is an advantage if you have:
Experience from retail.
Experience with digital products, platforms, customer journeys, data, automation or AI.
Experience developing digital marketing methods, briefing processes or shared marketing capabilities.
Experience driving organisational change, transformation and continuous improvement.
Experience from fashion, apparel, retail or another design-led product environment.

Location and Application
The position is based at the company’s head office in Gothenburg and requires regular on-site presence. International travel may be required.
We warmly welcome your application by 22 November via maquire.se (https://maquire.se/lediga-jobb/). If you have any questions, please contact Igor Glavan, 0701-765828, igor.glavan@jerrie.se or Jonna Berglöv, 0763-034100, jonna.berglov@jerrie.se

jobs.occupation: Tax Technology Consultant | Tax Technology & Operations | Stockholm
jobs.description:
Do you want to help businesses turn complex tax rules into practical technology solutions? Join EY's Nordic Tax Technology and Operations team in Stockholm and work where indirect tax, finance and technology meet. 
 
 
The opportunity
 
Digital reporting requirements are changing how companies manage VAT and e-invoicing. In this role, you will help clients understand what new requirements mean for their data, processes and systems, and support them from early analysis through implementation. 
 
You will collaborate with tax specialists, finance teams, IT architects, developers and technology providers across the Nordics and our wider international network. This role offers the opportunity to build specialist expertise in a fast-developing area while contributing to major client projects and the continued growth of our Nordic offering. 
 
 
Your key responsibilities
 
Your responsibilities will be adapted to your experience and may include: 
Lead client workshops to understand current processes, identify needs and define requirements. 
Translate indirect tax and e-invoicing regulations into clear process and system requirements. 
Design practical solutions and documentation that connect tax, finance and technology. 
Work with client teams and delivery specialists to implement and test solutions, including SAP-based e-invoicing solutions. 
Coordinate stakeholders and contribute insights on developments such as ViDA and real-time reporting. 

 
 
Skills and attributes for success
 
You enjoy making complex topics easier to understand and can connect business needs with technology. You are comfortable working with different stakeholders and take a structured, collaborative approach to delivery. 
 
 
Qualifications
 
A university degree in taxation, business, finance, information systems, computer science or a related field.
Relevant experience in indirect tax, tax technology, finance transformation, ERP implementation or a comparable advisory environment.
The ability to analyze complex requirements and turn them into clear processes, documentation or technology solutions.
Strong communication skills in English and the ability to work effectively with both business and technology stakeholders.
Knowledge of SAP, particularly SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (SAP DRC)

 
 
Meritorious
 
Experience with VAT or GST, e-invoicing, digital reporting or tax compliance transformation.
Tax technology platforms such as Avalara, Vertex or Thomson Reuters.
Familiarity with Peppol, country-specific e-invoicing frameworks, ViDA or real-time reporting requirements.
Experience with requirements gathering, solution design, user acceptance testing, agile delivery or project coordination.
Experience working with multinational organisations, cross-border teams or large-scale transformation projects.

 
 
As a person you are
 
Curious and motivated to learn in a fast-changing specialist area.
Analytical and solution-oriented, with an eye for both detail and the bigger picture.
Collaborative, clear and confident when working across tax, finance and technology teams.

 
 
What we offer you
 
Continuous learning: Develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: Tools and flexibility to make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: Insights, coaching, and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: Be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice.

 
 
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
 
Please submit your application no later than 29th of November 2026. Selection and interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis. If you have questions about the role, please contact Oda Kristin Borgesen at Oda.Kristin.Borgesen@no.ey.com . For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Simon Aspler at Simon.Aspler@se.ey.com. 

Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.

At EY, we celebrate diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you have any questions, require assistance, or need adjustments to the recruitment process due to a disability, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We’re here to support you.

EY | Building a better working world 
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.occupation: Head of Public Affairs at Volvo CE
jobs.description:
Company description:
Volvo Construction Equipment 
Job description:    The construction equipment industry is undergoing a major transformation. Electrification, digitalization, sustainability ambitions, industrial policy and geopolitical developments are reshaping the conditions for our industry. At Volvo Construction Equipment (Volvo CE), we are committed to driving this transformation and building the world we want to live in for our customers, employees and society. 
 We are looking for an experienced and business-oriented Head of Public Affairs to shape the external policy environment, strengthen strategic partnerships and translate political and regulatory developments into business opportunities. 
 This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of business strategy, technology, geopolitics and public policy in one of the world's leading industrial companies. You will advise senior executives on developments shaping our industry, represent Volvo CE in influential external arenas and help define the conditions for future competitiveness and sustainable growth. 
 What you will do 
As Head of Public Affairs, you will lead Volvo CE's Global Public Affairs agenda, serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership and represent the company in dialogues with policymakers, regulators and other key stakeholders. 
 Working closely with Volvo Group Public Affairs and colleagues across Volvo CE, you will ensure that our business priorities are reflected in relevant policy discussions and advocacy initiatives. 
 Your key responsibilities will include: Shape and execute our Public Affairs agenda: Develop and implement Volvo CE's Public Affairs strategy in close coordination with Volvo Group Public Affairs, aligned with business priorities and long-term competitiveness. 
 Anticipate,  interpret and influence external developments: Monitor, analyze and influence political, regulatory, economic and geopolitical developments across Swedish, European and international arenas. Translate insights from policy, industry trends, research and broader societal developments into business opportunities and strategic guidance.  
 Advise senior leadership: Provide actionable insights on political, regulatory and geopolitical developments, supporting business strategy and executive stakeholder engagement. 
 Lead strategic advocacy: Develop evidence-based policy positions, advocacy plans and key messages in close collaboration with strategy, technology, sustainability, communications, legal and commercial functions. 
 Build trusted partnerships: Develop and maintain relationships with policymakers, government authorities, industry associations, NGOs, think tanks and customers, positioning Volvo CE as a trusted and constructive partner in the transition towards more sustainable and productive solutions. 
 Drive external engagement: Represent Volvo CE in industry forums, policy discussions, executive roundtables and strategic external engagements, acting as a trusted ambassador for the company among influential stakeholders in Sweden, Europe and globally. 
 Strengthen Group-wide collaboration: Coordinate Volvo CE's contributions to Volvo Group Public Affairs initiatives and policy positions, ensuring alignment with Group priorities while advancing the interests of the construction equipment business. 
 Who are you? 
You are a strategic, proactive and results-oriented professional who combines political understanding with sound business judgment. 
 You build trust and credibility with senior stakeholders, communicate complex issues clearly and drive results through collaboration and influence rather than formal authority. 
 You are comfortable working independently in an international environment, balancing long-term strategic objectives with effective execution. You have a genuine interest in understanding the forces shaping society, business and industry, and enjoy staying ahead of developments through policy analysis, research, global trends and geopolitical developments. 
 Above all, you are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to Volvo CE's competitiveness and the transformation of the construction equipment industry. 
 We are looking for an experienced Public Affairs professional with strong political judgment, business acumen and a proven ability to influence policy outcomes. 
 To be successful in this role, we believe you bring: 
  Significant relevant experience, ideally in Public Affairs, government relations, regulatory affairs or a related strategic function, gained in industry, government or relevant organizations. 
 Strong knowledge of Swedish and European political institutions, regulatory frameworks and decision-making processes, with an international perspective. 
 Proven experience in developing advocacy strategies, influencing policy developments and advising senior executives. 
 Solid business and industrial understanding, with the ability to connect political and regulatory developments to business strategy and commercial opportunities. 
 A relevant university degree in political science, law, economics, business administration, engineering or a related field. 
 Excellent communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with fluency in English & Swedish. 
  
Additional merits include: 
  Experience from construction equipment, automotive, transport, energy or other industrial sectors. 
 Established networks within relevant political institutions, government agencies and industry organizations. 
 Experience working with EU industrial, climate, trade or competitiveness policies.

jobs.occupation: Certification Engineer
jobs.description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future. 
Role Summary
As a Certification Engineer within Scania BID, you will work mainly with your own certification areas as an expert within Internal Combustion Engines (ICE) and Electrified (e-power) solutions for Power Solution (Power Generation, Industrial and Marine) applications. You will support designers and other teams enabling compliant and certified products, including improving internal processes, coaching teams, and performing inspections and certification activities.
The team works together with the designers to make sure they understand the regulatory requirements and have a robust plan to successfully meet them.
Job Responsibilities
As a certification engineer within Homologation you will handle certification related questions within Internal Combustion Engines and Electrified solutions for Power Solution applications and contributing to the team deliveries.
Your responsibilities will include:
• Planning and performing certification inspections, tests and audits with technical service and authorities.
• Coaching and inspiring the involved teams from e.g. design, project managers with details regarding our products necessary for type approvals.
• Monitor the legal requirements changes for your legal areas, working through Scania’s distributors and participate in lobbying activities.
• Improve the processes and the collaboration with others.
• Follow up deviations and implementations.
• Supporting the markets with details regarding our product necessary for the national type approvals.
Who You Are
We are looking for a curious person inspired by challenging objectives. An engineer with drive and preferably experience with certification, Internal Combustion Engines (ICE) and/or emissions.
Working in a multicultural team, to be fluent in English – both written and spoken is a prerequisite.
You are: 
Enthusiastic, have a can-do mentality combined with a structured way of working and prioritize among long term and short term tasks.
Flexible and adapt actions and behaviour depending on pre-requisites, while still maintaining a high integrity.
A team player capable of working and delivering results together with others as well as on your own, and you take the initiative to solve complex tasks.
Have a talent for cross-functional work and are good at developing and maintaining a broad network within the company.

This Is Us
The department of Product Compliance consists of two groups, Homologation, ECH and National Regulations, ECR working closely together with compliance of Scania products. The work is performed both internally at Scania BID as well as with our colleagues within TRATON group. We are organized in smaller teams for closer cooperation, valuing team spirit within our entire network, offering support and guidance. We succeed, fail and learn as a team! 
Scania Offers
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.
Application
Your application should include a CV and any relevant certificates. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes.
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-15. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

jobs.occupation: Technical Lead – IoT to Alfa Laval!
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced software engineer looking to lead through technical expertise, mentorship, and collaboration – while continuing to develop hands-on software? For Alfa Laval's IoT Development Team, we are now looking for a Technical Lead to drive the development of scalable IoT solutions for Alfa Laval's global product portfolio!
About the role
In this role, you will be part of a collaborative IoT development team, serving as the technical anchor and guide for engineers while turning business requirements into scalable cloud solutions.
Alfa Laval contributes to a more sustainable future through technical innovation. The company's solutions help customers improve efficiency across industries such as marine, energy, water treatment, food production, and pharmaceuticals.
Alfa Laval's IoT solutions enable remote support, data visualization, and performance analytics for industrial machinery. By analyzing data in real time, the systems help global customers optimize operations and regulatory compliance, reduce unplanned downtime, and lower their environmental footprint. Alfa Laval offers a collaborative and inclusive environment where employees are encouraged to take initiative, share ideas, and turn innovations into reality.
You are Offered
Global Impact within IoT: The opportunity to build advanced IoT solutions that connect industrial machinery and are used worldwide.
International Collaboration: Extensive collaboration with international teams and global stakeholders in an open, non-hierarchical environment.
Long-Term Development: Strong opportunities for technical growth, broader architecture responsibilities, and flexible career paths within a world-leading industrial group.
Flexibility & Balance: A collaborative work environment with a hybrid setup (based in either Flemingsberg or Lund) and a healthy work-life balance.

Work tasks
As Technical Lead in one of the IoT Development Teams, you will work closely with developers, Product Owners, Delivery Leads, business stakeholders, and DevOps teams to translate business needs into robust, dependable technical solutions. The role entails end-to-end responsibility for technical design, implementation, and estimation, while remaining actively engaged in hands-on software development and coaching the team forward. Your primary responsibilities:
Lead technical design, solution definition, and estimation activities, translating business requirements into scalable and maintainable solutions.  
Mentor engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, testing practices, and the promotion of engineering best practices.  
Collaborate across teams and stakeholders to align solutions, manage dependencies, and ensure efficient delivery.  
Support the full software development lifecycle, including implementation, deployment, maintenance, and operational handover.  
Remain actively involved in hands-on software development and technical problem solving, contributing where your expertise provides the greatest value.  
Ensure solutions meet requirements for performance, usability, maintainability, stability, and cybersecurity.

We are looking for someone who 
Has extensive software development experience with a strong focus on C# and .NET / .NET Core.
Has experience designing scalable backend systems and APIs for distributed environments.
Has practical experience with cloud development, primarily in Microsoft Azure (experience with AWS or GCP is also valued), as well as containerization with Docker.
Has experience in technical mentorship – you enjoy guiding other developers, conducting code reviews, and establishing engineering best practices within an agile team.
Is fully proficient in English, both spoken and written (corporate and team language).

It is meritorious if you have
Experience in IoT and Telemetry: Hands-on work with connected devices, industrial monitoring, edge computing, or time-series databases (e.g., TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
Broader Architectural Expertise: Familiarity with microservices, distributed system design, or event-driven architecture.
DevOps & Tooling: Experience with DevOps practices, automated deployments, Azure DevOps, Linux-based environments, or scripting languages (e.g., Python).
Frontend Understanding: Basic familiarity with modern frontend frameworks such as Angular.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Supportive
Goal oriented
Orderly
Stable
Responsible
Assertive

Other information
A background check is part of the final stage of the recruitment process.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.occupation: Sales Coordinator to an International Company in the MedTech Industry!
jobs.description:
Are you a Finnish-speaking professional who enjoys taking ownership, coordinating complex processes, and working with multiple stakeholders? Do you have experience in order management, sales support, or B2B administration? Are you someone who likes to take responsibility and ensure that everything runs smoothly from start to finish? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!
We are currently looking for a Sales Coordinator to join a well-established international company within the medical technology industry. In this role, you will play an important part in ensuring that customer orders are managed efficiently, accurately, and delivered according to plan.
You will primarily support the Finnish market and become part of a collaborative Nordic sales organization based in Stockholm.
About the Role:
As a Sales Coordinator, you will have end-to-end responsibility for customer orders, from the initial order placement through to delivery and final invoicing.
This is much more than an order administration position. You will be responsible for keeping the entire process together, identifying potential issues, coordinating different departments, and ensuring that every order is handled correctly and within the agreed timeframe.
You will act as a central point of contact between customers, the sales organization, service teams, project managers, international factories, and the finance department.
Your Main Responsibilities:
Receive, review, and register customer orders, primarily via email.
Ensure that order documentation, pricing, and delivery terms are accurate and complete.
Communicate with customers and sales representatives to clarify or obtain missing order information.
Coordinate complex orders involving multiple factories, deliveries, and internal functions.
Monitor order progress and ensure that products are delivered according to schedule.
Collaborate with service coordinators and project managers to prepare for product installations.
Ensure a smooth and accurate handover to the service organization.
Follow up on open orders and ensure that invoicing takes place at the correct time.
Manage partial deliveries and invoicing in multiple stages.
Communicate deviations and changes in invoicing schedules to the finance department.
Take ownership of your orders and ensure that each process is followed through to completion.

About You:
We are looking for someone with previous experience in order coordination, order management, sales support, or qualified B2B customer service.
You have a good understanding of how different parts of an order process are connected, from receiving an order to coordinating deliveries and ensuring that invoicing is completed correctly.
You are comfortable taking ownership of your work, coordinating multiple stakeholders, and handling both routine tasks and more complex situations. You understand the importance of keeping track of details while maintaining an overview of the entire process.
To Succeed in This Role, We Believe You Have:
Approximately two years of experience in a similar position.
Previous experience in order coordination, order management, sales support, or qualified B2B customer service.
Experience independently managing and following up on order processes, preferably from order placement through to delivery and invoicing.
An understanding of how orders, deliveries, installations, and invoicing are connected.
Experience coordinating several internal and external stakeholders.
The ability to manage complex cases and keep multiple processes moving simultaneously.
Previous experience working with ERP or other business management systems.
Good general computer skills and the ability to quickly learn new systems and processes.
Excellent communication skills in Finnish and English, both written and spoken.

Experience working with SAP or Salesforce is also considered a plus.
Who Are You as a Person?
You are a responsible, structured, and proactive individual who enjoys taking ownership and driving processes forward.
You are detail-oriented and understand the importance of accuracy when handling customer orders, deliveries, and invoicing. At the same time, you are able to maintain an overview and ensure that all the different parts of the process come together.
You are confident in making decisions and taking action when something needs to be resolved. Rather than waiting for someone else to follow up, you take initiative and make sure things get done.
You also have strong communication skills and enjoy working with different stakeholders, both internally and externally. You understand the importance of keeping everyone informed and ensuring smooth collaboration between departments.
Interested?
Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? We would love to hear from you!
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Head of Production
jobs.description:
Did you know that Sweden's largest shipyard for ship repair and conversion projects is in Landskrona? At Oresund DryDocks, vessels from across Northern Europe and beyond come to us for complex repair, maintenance and conversion projects. With a strong reputation for quality, safety and delivery performance, we are a leading player in the maritime industry.
Our success is built on the expertise and commitment of approximately 110 employees, working across project management, engineering, production and support functions. 
We are now looking for a Head of Production to lead and further develop our production organization.
The Role as Head of Production
As Head of Production, you will have overall responsibility for leading, developing and optimizing the production organization through your department managers within Steel, Piping, Mechanical, and Dock & Transport.
You will ensure that the organization has the right resources, competencies, processes and working methods in place to successfully deliver projects according to established targets for safety, quality, cost efficiency and delivery performance.
As a member of the management team, you will play a key role in driving operational excellence and contributing to the company's long-term strategic development. The position requires a visible and engaged leadership style, with a strong presence in the business and close collaboration with employees, customers and stakeholders.
Experience
You have several years of experience in a senior production leadership role within the maritime, shipyard, manufacturing or other project-driven industrial sectors.
You have a proven track record of:

Leading managers and larger production organizations through delegated responsibility

Driving operational performance and achieving demanding business objectives

Developing organizations, processes and working methods to improve efficiency, productivity and delivery precision

Building and strengthening a proactive safety culture with a strong focus on HSEQ

Managing operations in an international business environment

Experience from project-driven production environments where flexibility, coordination and customer focus are critical is highly valued.
Leadership Profile
You are a confident and inspiring leader who leads by example. Through clear communication and a structured approach, you create engagement, accountability and commitment throughout the organization.
You are results-oriented and combine a strong business mindset with a genuine interest in people development. You can balance strategic thinking with operational execution and are comfortable making decisions in a dynamic environment.
To succeed in the role, you should have:

Strong leadership and people management skills

Excellent planning and organizational abilities

A strong focus on quality, safety and customer satisfaction

Good technical understanding and the ability to translate business objectives into operational activities

Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, written and spoken

Meritorious Qualifications

Experience from the shipbuilding, ship repair or maritime industry

Experience in Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement

What We Offer
At Oresund DryDocks, you will become part of a highly skilled and dedicated team operating within an exciting international industry.
We offer a challenging and varied leadership role with significant opportunities to influence both operational performance and the future development of the company. Our organization is characterized by short decision-making paths, a collaborative culture and a strong commitment to continuous improvement.
You will work alongside talented colleagues from diverse backgrounds who share a passion for delivering high-quality solutions to our customers. We believe that every employee contributes to our success and we actively support both personal and professional development.
As our business continues to grow, new opportunities and challenges arise every day. We therefore seek a leader who enjoys being present in the operation, building trust with employees, customers and subcontractors, and creating the conditions for long-term success.
To learn more about us, please visit www.oddab.eu
Application
We welcome your application through CV upload or LinkedIn profile.
Selection and interviews will be conducted continuously. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.
Background checks and pre-employment medical examinations form part of our recruitment process.
For further information, please contact:
Jonas Bessing
Head of Recruitment
+46 (0)736-264750 or at jbe@oddab.eu.
Join Oresund DryDocks and become a key contributor to the continued success and development of Sweden's leading shipyard for repair and conversion projects.

jobs.occupation: Environment Expert
jobs.description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. 
And we need people like you to make it happen.
We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.
Job Summary
We are looking for an environmental expert to be a part of AB Tetra Paks Site Management team, reporting to AB Tetra Paks Environment manager.

jobs.occupation: CEO for a pioneering technology company
jobs.description:
Do you thrive on creating business value, leading people and bringing pioneering technology to market? Would you like to spearhead a company developing innovative solutions for growing international markets?
Our client is looking for a CEO to lead its next phase, working closely with the engineers and scientists behind the company's technology. You will develop the business, bring the organisation together around clear priorities and build the international relationships that turn technical progress into commercial opportunities.
This is an opportunity to lead the commercialization of proprietary technology, combining the expertise of a highly qualified technical team with your own ability to build an international business.
Does this sound like the opportunity for you? Read on.

About the role
As CEO, you will lead and develop the company across its two business areas. You will shape the business strategy with the board and take responsibility for its execution within the agreed budget, translating it into priorities and shared goals.
You will act on and create business opportunities and personally drive key commercial relationships and negotiations. Working closely with the technical leadership, CFO/COO and board, you will unite customer needs, technical capabilities and financial priorities.
The role calls for commercial judgement and enough technical understanding to work confidently with customers, partners and specialists. You will draw on the expertise within the organisation while taking responsibility for decisions, direction and progress.
The company is based in Gothenburg, Sweden. The role requires regular on-site presence with the team and international travel.

In this role you will

Develop and execute the commercial direction in alignment with the board, focusing on markets and opportunities with the strongest commercial potential.

Use and develop your international network to build relationships with industrial customers and partners.

Personally drive complex business opportunities from initial dialogue through negotiation to agreement.

Build internal structures, with clear responsibilities, decision-making and follow-up.

Lead the organisation towards shared goals, aligning technical development and resources with business priorities.

Prioritize resources towards the most attractive opportunities within the agreed budget, taking responsibility for cash flow and funding planning together with the CFO/COO and board.

Communicate progress, opportunities and risks clearly to employees, the board and investors.

Build relationships with investors and lead capital raising initiatives.

To succeed in this role you will bring

Experience leading and developing a technology-intensive business, business unit or commercial function, with responsibility for people, resources and financial results.

The ability to turn strategic goals into clear priorities, effective ways of working and measurable progress.

A hands-on approach with the ability to deliver results in a small organization with limited resources.

A proven record of personally developing and closing complex international B2B technology agreements with industrial customers.

A relevant international industry network and experience bringing new technology to market, including customer testing, qualification or development partnerships.

Solid technical understanding and commercial experience from technology-driven markets such as advanced electronics, materials, energy technology, industrial technology or related fields.

A relevant educational background in technology or business, or equivalent professional experience, excellent English and the ability to travel internationally.

Additional experience we value
Previous CEO responsibility, capital raising and experience in a listed company is valuable. Experience in industrial automation, telecommunications, sensor technology or advanced manufacturing may also be relevant where it includes comparable commercialisation and industrial business development.

Personal qualities
You are a clear and approachable leader who takes responsibility for the whole business. You listen to the expertise around you, make considered decisions and explain the priorities behind them. You enjoy creating opportunities and stay involved in the work needed to move them forward. When conditions change or the way ahead is uncertain, you maintain focus, adapt your approach and keep people informed. You build trust through realistic expectations and consistent follow-through.

Application and contact
Do you recognize yourself in this description? We would love to hear from you!
Please send us your application, we look forward to meeting you.
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so do not wait to apply.

jobs.occupation: Support & Digital Workplace Manager to the Stockholm School of Economics
jobs.description:
We offer you 
ITS at the Stockholm School of Economics (SSE), technology is a critical enabler for world-class education, research and administration. As digitalization, automation and AI continue to transform the way people work, we are investing in the next generation of support services and digital workplace experiences. 
We are now looking for a Support & Digital Workplace Manager to lead and develop our Support team within IT Services. The support team is split into 4 functions with separate responsibilities, AV and lecture hall, ServiceDesk, ExEd support, and Student IT Support. 
This is a unique opportunity to combine people leadership, service management and digital transformation in an international and knowledge-driven environment. You will have a central role in shaping how support services evolve and how SSE leverages automation, self-service and AI to improve the user experience and increase organizational productivity. 
As part of the newly established leadership structure within IT Services, you will have significant influence over the future development of support services and the digital workplace at SSE 
About the Role 
This is an opportunity for a leader who is equally comfortable managing daily operations while driving longer-term transformation initiatives. 
You will lead SSE's Support team and be responsible for ensuring a high-quality user experience for students, faculty and staff. At the same time, you will drive the development of support services, processes, self-service capabilities, and AI-enabled ways of working. 
The role is expected to remain actively involved in operational support delivery and end-user services while providing leadership and direction for the wider support function. 
The support function plays a vital role within IT Services, supporting users across a broad range of technologies, platforms and workplace services including Microsoft 365, identity and access management, endpoint management, collaboration tools and end-user support.  
Responsibilities 
Participate actively in Service Desk operations and end-user support. 
Lead, coach and develop the Support team, including performance reviews, staffing and responsibility for the work environment. 
Plan and prioritize daily operations, balancing workloads and ensuring timely resolution of support requests. 
Monitor service quality, user feedback and performance metrics, and turn findings into improvements. 
Improve service levels and the overall user experience by developing support processes, documentation and knowledge sharing, using user feedback and service metrics to drive continuous improvement. 
Develop self-service and automation and support the effective use of AI-enabled tools where they add value. 
Work with students, faculty and staff to understand their needs and identify improvements to digital workplace services. 
Coordinate with colleagues across infrastructure, development and security to resolve issues and improve services. 

Your profile 
We are looking for an engaged and forward-thinking leader with a strong user focus and a passion for continuous improvement. 
You understand what excellent support looks like and have the ability to develop both services and people in that direction. You enjoy creating structure, building high-performing teams, and driving change in a collaborative environment. 
You are curious about emerging technologies and see AI, automation, and modern workplace solutions as opportunities to enhance both employee experience and operational effectiveness. 
You are a strong communicator who can build trust across technical and non-technical stakeholder groups and translate business needs into practical solutions. 
Requirements 
Experience leading, coordinating or developing IT support, service desk or end-user services. 
Experience working with IT Service Management principles and processes. 
Experience driving operational improvements and service development initiatives. 
Experience managing stakeholders and working closely with business users. 
Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 and modern workplace technologies. 
Experience using data and service metrics to improve performance. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English 
Written and verbal communication skills in Swedish 

Meritorious 
Experience leading support or workplace transformation initiatives. 
Experience as a manager with formal responsibility for employees, preferably within IT support, service desk or end-user services. 
Experience implementing or supporting Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform or other AI-enabled workplace tools. 
Experience with automation, self-service platforms or service optimization. 
Experience from higher education or other knowledge-intensive organizations.

Other 
This is a full-time, permanent position with an initial six-month probationary period. The position is based in central Stockholm. Start date is as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Senior Sales Manager BESS Germany & Central Europe
jobs.description:

.

jobs.occupation: F15 Graduate Programme 2027
jobs.description:
Are you eager to influence the future direction of Arla Foods? Do you envision yourself as a future leader?
How will you make an impact?
The Arla F15 Graduate Programme is a two-year, international development programme designed for graduates who want to learn quickly, explore different areas of a global business and grow into future leadership opportunities.
Through three eight-month rotations, you will work on meaningful business projects, build an international network and develop the confidence, skills and experience to make an impact at Arla. Business areas for projects may include Marketing, Sales, HR, Strategy, Sustainability, Business Development, and Supply Chain. We will match you with a suitable department based on business needs and your profile, offering you the chance to learn and make a difference. Your F15 Graduate journey begins on 1st September 2027.

First rotation (8 months - Aarhus, Denmark) Based at one of our offices in Aarhus you will be assigned a strategically important project somewhere in the business.
Second rotation (8 months - Outside Denmark) You will have more influence over your second project assignment, which will give you the opportunity to continue growing in a meaningful way whilst adding real value to Arla.
Third rotation (8 months - Any Arla market) You will collaborate with the business to source potential high impact projects for your third rotation. You will have the most influence over projects during your final rotation.

 
What will make you a successful F15 Graduate?
To apply for the F15 Graduate Programme, please ensure that you meet the following criteria
You should either be in the process of completing, or have completed, a bachelor’s or master’s degree between September 2025 and September 2027. We welcome diverse educational backgrounds but seek candidates with a strong drive towards a business-focused career.
International experience gained from working, studying or volunteering abroad is an advantage.
Preferably at least one year of relevant work experience from student jobs or a minimum of six months of internship experience.
You are globally mobile and willing to go on one or two rotations abroad during the two-year programme. As your first rotation is based in Aarhus, Denmark you will need to relocate unless you already reside in the local area. Arla Foods will support you with this relocation.

 
This programme will suit graduates who have leadership aspirations and an ambitious mindset, which combines strategic thinking with a passion for results. A global mindset is essential, as is the ability to build positive relationships and strong influencing skills. The ideal candidate should be curious, competitive, and open to change, demonstrating resilience, while also being humble, self-aware, and open to feedback.
Throughout the rotations you will receive a variety of development opportunities every step of the way. To ensure your professional and personal development, you will benefit from
Responsibilities from day one, enabling on-the-job learning in three different areas
Graduate development camps, taking place in different markets with your graduate colleagues
One-to-one mentoring and sparring from senior leaders
Be part of a supportive graduate community across all Arla Futures programmes 

Important information before applying
The application period for the F15 Graduate Programme runs from 2nd November 2026 until 2359 CET on 3rd January 2027. Before applying, please ensure you have prepared your CV and cover letter in English. You will be asked a series of questions on the application page, so we recommend that you start the application process from a computer instead of a mobile phone.
For additional information, read more about the F15 Graduate Programme on our website. Here, you can get inspiration from some of our previous and current F15s and learn more about the programme. You can also read more about what to expect from the recruitment process on our website.
Shape the Future of Dairy
Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Senior Power BI & Microsoft Fabric Consultant
jobs.description:
Exciting Opportunity at Tekkli: Senior Power BI & Microsoft Fabric Consultant
Join Tekkli, where innovation meets expertise!
We are looking for an experienced Senior Power BI & Microsoft Fabric Consultant to join our growing team in Helsingborg. If you are passionate about turning complex data into meaningful business insights, building scalable analytical solutions, and working with modern data technologies, we would love to hear from you.
At Tekkli, we combine business understanding, technical expertise, and innovation to create solutions that make a real difference. We value curiosity, continuous learning, and people who challenge conventional ways of working.
Your Role
As a Senior Power BI & Microsoft Fabric Consultant, you will play a key role in developing and strengthening modern Business Intelligence and analytics solutions.
You will work at the intersection of business and technology, transforming business requirements into scalable data models, insightful dashboards, and reliable analytical solutions.
Your responsibilities will include:
Designing, developing, and maintaining advanced Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models.
Building reusable and governed analytical solutions that enable self-service reporting.
Developing and optimizing complex DAX measures and calculations.
Designing dimensional data models, including star schemas, fact tables, and dimensions.
Building data transformations and processing solutions using SQL, Python, and PySpark.
Working with Microsoft Fabric capabilities such as Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and Notebooks.
Optimizing performance, data quality, and reliability across analytical solutions.
Translating business requirements into meaningful KPIs and actionable insights.
Collaborating closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and other technical teams.
Contributing to modern data architecture, governance, documentation, and best practices.

Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with business understanding and a genuine interest in solving complex problems.
You are someone who:
Has a strong analytical mindset and enjoys turning data into business value.
Takes ownership and drives solutions from requirements to delivery.
Is comfortable navigating both business and technical discussions.
Enjoys sharing knowledge and collaborating with colleagues.
Is curious about new technologies and continuously looks for smarter ways of working.
Values clean, maintainable, and scalable solutions.

Technical Skills & Experience
We believe you have:
At least 6 years of experience within Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, or Data Engineering.
Extensive hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI, including enterprise reporting and semantic modeling.
Advanced knowledge of DAX, including complex calculations, filter context, time intelligence, and performance optimization.
Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, star schemas, relationships, and data model design.
Strong SQL skills for data transformation, analytical queries, and data validation.
Practical experience with Python and PySpark for data processing and transformation.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Pipelines, and Notebooks, or equivalent experience from modern Azure data platforms.
Experience with Power Query and M language.
Understanding of modern data architectures, including Delta Lake and Bronze/Silver/Gold data layers.
Experience with data governance, security, and reusable analytical solutions.

Additional experience that is highly valued:
Understanding of KPIs such as sales performance, average transaction value, basket analysis, and comparable sales.
Experience with Databricks, Azure Data Lake, or Azure Data Factory.
Knowledge of CI/CD, Git integration, and deployment pipelines.
Experience with governed self-service analytics and enterprise BI modernization.
Excellent communication skills in English are required.

Why Tekkli?
At Tekkli, we believe that great people create great solutions. We offer an environment where you can grow, explore new technologies, influence how we work, and contribute to exciting customer projects.
We value long-term relationships, knowledge sharing, and a culture where ideas are encouraged and expertise is shared.
About Tekkli
Tekkli is a digital transformation company driven by data, tech and human insight. Our services in strategy, digital development, data, AI and cloud & integration allow us to work with and develop our customers into the most successful companies on the market.
We believe in long-term relationships and help companies and society renew themselves and continue their development towards the future.
Within Tekkli, there is an obvious challenge that infuses the company as a whole: If there is a more intelligent solution, we will discover it.
How to Apply
Are you ready to take the next step in your career and join a team passionate about technology and innovation?
We would love to hear from you!
Please submit your CV, together with a brief introduction and your availability, through our application page:
https://tekkli.com/apply/
We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Join our Backend Team in Gothenburg
jobs.description:
TECHLA is a Gothenburg-based consulting company working with modern product development across software, embedded systems, cloud and DevOps.
We started TECHLA with a simple idea: to build the kind of consulting company we would want to work for ourselves. We want to build long-term relationships, work with great people and create an environment where both our consultants and our clients can thrive.
We believe in transparency, trust and giving people the freedom and responsibility to grow. Our consultants should feel that they are part of something, have a real influence and are rewarded for the value they create.
At TECHLA, technology matters – but people matter even more. We believe the best results come from skilled people who take ownership, work closely together and genuinely care about what they deliver.
We are big enough to deliver, but small enough to care.
We’re looking for experienced Backend Developers in Gothenburg who combine strong technical skills with ownership, curiosity and a genuine drive to move things forward.
What you’ll be working with
You’ll join a development team at one of our clients, building and operating modern backend services and cloud-based platforms for connected products and digital services.
The exact technology stack will vary by assignment. It may include Java, C#/.NET, Python or Go, together with AWS and/or Azure. Some teams focus on customer-facing backend services, while others develop cloud platforms, integrations and developer tools.
You’ll work in a collaborative, DevOps-oriented environment and contribute throughout the service lifecycle, from design and development to deployment, monitoring, operations and continuous improvement.
Your work may include
Developing and maintaining backend services using Java, C#/.NET, Python and/or Go
Designing and building cloud-native solutions on AWS or Azure
Building REST APIs, microservices and integrations
Working with event-driven systems and distributed architectures
Using cloud services such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB and SQS
Working with containers and Kubernetes, depending on the team
Improving CI/CD, automation, monitoring, logging and service reliability
Contributing to code reviews, technical discussions and architecture decisions

Skills & qualifications
We’re looking for someone with:
At least 5 years of professional backend development experience
Strong experience in at least one of the following: Java, C#/.NET, Python or Go.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Azure
Experience building and operating APIs, services or distributed systems
A good understanding of software quality, reliability and maintainability
Fluent written and spoken English
A BSc or MSc in Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Good to have
AWS serverless experience, such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB or SQS
Experience with Azure services
Experience with Kubernetes and containerized applications
CI/CD and DevOps practices
Event-driven architecture or tools such as Kafka
Experience in connected services, IoT, automotive or telecom
Fluent written and spoken Swedish

The mindset we’re looking for
For us, being a great engineer is about more than technical skills.
We’re looking for people with a strong consulting mindset – people who understand that great consulting is about creating real value, taking ownership and being someone both the team and the client can rely on.
You’re highly skilled at what you do, but you’re also a doer who cares about quality. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem. You take initiative, move things forward and care about delivering work you can genuinely be proud of.
At the same time, you genuinely enjoy working with others. You communicate openly, share knowledge, contribute to a positive team dynamic and believe that the best results are created together.
You take responsibility for the bigger picture, stay solution-oriented and aren’t afraid to go the extra mile when it makes a difference. At the same time, you’re humble, genuine and enjoy working with people who challenge and support each other.
In short, we’re looking for engineers who want to go beyond – technically, professionally and as part of a team.
We’re open to both employment and freelance/subcontractor setups – so whether you’re looking to join TECHLA or take on your next assignment as an independent consultant, we’d love to hear from you.
Feel free to reach out to johanna.bornemyr@techla.se or submit your application, and we’ll be happy to tell you more about the opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Technical Product Owner - Embedded Systems
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
This position reports to: R&D Team Lead.
Your role and responsibilities
At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration, combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities, are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions.
Are you passionate about embedded technology and motivated by taking broad technical ownership of products throughout their lifecycle? Do you enjoy bridging technical details with system-level thinking while working closely with customers and stakeholders?
We are looking for a Technical Product Owner to play a key role in the continued development and technical evolution of ABB's embedded product portfolio. In this position, you will combine your expertise in embedded electronics and software with a strong product mindset, ensuring products continue to meet customer needs, quality standards, and future business requirements.
You will work across multiple disciplines and collaborate closely with R&D teams, product management, manufacturing, suppliers, and customers. jobs.occupation: Mechanical Design Engineer – Dog Transportation in Car
jobs.description:
Bring your life
Are you passionate about developing products where safety, engineering excellence, and user experience come together? Do you want to help create innovative solutions that allow people and their dogs to travel safely and comfortably together?
As part of our Dog Transportation category, you'll contribute to solutions that combine thoughtful design, engineering excellence, and industry-leading safety. With an exciting product portfolio and roadmap ahead, you'll help shape dog transportation solutions that make adventures with dogs safer, easier, and more enjoyable.
 
What you'll do at Thule
As a Mechanical Design Engineer - Dog Transportation in Car, you'll be part of our committed engineering team developing innovative dog transportation solutions for vehicles, including dog crates and related products. Together, we take ideas from concept to finished product through a structured and collaborative development process.
In this role, you will design and develop components in CAD, create high-quality technical specifications, and collaborate closely with project managers, simulation and test engineers, and prototype specialists to solve technical challenges and ensure every detail meets the high standards and requirements of the automotive industry.
You will take an active role in ordering and evaluating prototypes, analyzing test results, and using simulations to verify the strength and performance of your designs.
In addition, you will document technical solutions, manage design-related risks, and contribute to engineering best practices. Leading and supporting design reviews will be an important part of your role, helping ensure our products meet the highest standards of safety, quality, and sustainability.
 
What you bring
To succeed in this role, we believe you have a university degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, combined with some years of experience in mechanical design and product development.
You have worked with a variety of materials and understand how to optimize designs for functionality, durability, and safety. Experience from consumer products, automotive products, or other safety-critical applications is highly valuable. You are fluent in both Swedish and English.
As the role includes practical elements, we believe you thrive in a hands-on product development environment. As a person, you are self-driven, structured, and solution-oriented, with the ability to turn ideas into robust and well-engineered products. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines and can effectively manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
 
Why you should join Thule
At Thule, we are Proud to Be Thule. We believe anything is possible when we stay curious, take initiative and challenge ourselves. We encourage everyone to take ownership and make the most of their part of the business.
We believe we win as a team by collaborating across functions, sharing knowledge and supporting one another. United by our passion for our products, the outdoors and the Thule brand, we take pride in what we do and create a culture where everyone contributes, grows and has fun.
 
Hiring Process
Apply by submitting your application and resumé through “Apply for position” on our Thule Career Site. The application deadline is November 22, 2026.
Please make sure to not wait to show your interest until the last application date as interviews are held continuously during the process, and the position might be filled before the last application date. Please also note that we do not accept applications by e-mail.
If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact our Talent Acquisition Partner, Oscar Persson, at Oscar.persson@thule.com
We look forward to hearing from you!
Thule is a global sports and outdoor company. We offer high-quality products with smart features and a sustainable design that make it easy for people across the globe to live an active life. Under the motto Bring your life — and with a focus on consumer-driven innovation and long-term sustainability — we develop, manufacture and market products within the product categories Sport & Cargo Carriers (roof racks, roof boxes and carriers for transporting cycling, water and winter sports equipment, and rooftop tents mounted on a car), Active with Kids & Dogs (car seats, strollers, bike trailers, child bike seats and dog transport), RV Products (awnings, bike carriers and tents for RVs and caravans) and Bags & Mounts (backpacks, luggage and performance mounts).

jobs.occupation: Production Engineer to Quintus Technologies
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy combining engineering, practical problem-solving and improvements on the production floor? At Quintus Technologies in Västerås, you will help develop the facilities, equipment and technical conditions behind the assembly of advanced high-pressure systems.
About the role
Quintus is strengthening its production engineering function as production volumes grow. You will work with developing and optimizing workshop layouts, managing technical equipment and investments, and ensuring safe and efficient assembly operations. This is a hands-on engineering role with varied contacts, both internally and with external contractors.
Your responsibilities
As a Production Engineer at Quintus Technologies, you will play an important role in developing and maintaining our production facilities, ensuring that our workshop, equipment and infrastructure support safe and efficient manufacturing operations.
You will work closely with production, engineering and external partners to identify improvement opportunities, develop technical solutions and ensure that each customer project has the right conditions for successful assembly.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Developing and optimizing workshop layouts, production facilities and infrastructure to improve efficiency, capacity and safety.
Planning and managing equipment investments, from identifying needs and evaluating solutions to purchasing, installation and commissioning.
Preparing assembly stations for customer projects, including layouts, scaffolding, utilities and lifting arrangements.
Ensuring the availability, maintenance and certification of machinery, tools and lifting equipment, while coordinating external contractors and inspections.
Conducting risk assessments, developing technical instructions and supporting safe working methods, including complex manufacturing operations.

You will also contribute to workshop capacity assessments, support colleagues in technical matters and collaborate closely with the Production Developer on continuous improvement initiatives.
The role offers a great combination of hands-on problem-solving, technical development and project coordination, with plenty of opportunities to influence how our production facilities evolve.
Who are we looking for?
We believe you have a strong technical background and enjoy working in a production environment where you can combine practical problem-solving with technical development.
We are looking for someone who has:
Relevant technical education in production engineering, mechanical engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Experience in production engineering, industrial facilities, machinery, maintenance, tooling or technical investments.
A good understanding of workplace safety, risk assessments and equipment-related requirements.
Good communication skills in English and Swedish, both written and spoken.

As a person, you are structured, proactive and solution-oriented. You enjoy taking responsibility, managing several activities simultaneously and finding practical solutions to technical challenges.
You are a strong communicator who enjoys collaborating with people across different functions, from production staff and engineering to purchasing and external contractors. With a positive and constructive approach, you build good relationships and contribute to moving projects and improvements forward.
Additional experience we value:
Experience with lifting equipment, overhead cranes, third-party inspections or certified tools.
Experience managing investment projects, facility layouts or maintenance systems.
Experience in complex industrial assembly or large engineered products.

Why Quintus Technologies?
You will work close to the technology and the people who build it, with the opportunity to shape practical improvements in a growing production environment. Quintus combines advanced engineering, international customers and a collaborative, down-to-earth culture.
Location
The position is based in Västerås, Sweden.
About Quintus Technologies
Quintus Technologies specializes in the design, manufacturing, installation and support of high-pressure systems for sheet metal forming, advanced materials densification for high-quality industrial components as well as high pressure processing for food and beverage to deactivate the bacteria.
Headquartered in Västerås, Sweden, and represented in 45 countries worldwide. Quintus is the world leader in high-pressure technology, having delivered more than 1,900 systems globally to customers in industries such as aerospace, automotive, energy and medical implants.
Learn more about us at: www.quintustechnologies.com (http://www.quintustechnologies.com)
